name: Steel Trauma Plate
description: A curved steel plate cut for a carrier pouch. Heavy, cold, and the reason the rig exists.

name: Ceramic Plate
description: A rifle plate, chipped at one corner. Lighter than steel and it does not forgive a second hit in the same place.

name: Aramid Lining
description: A soft woven liner that laces into a vest. It does nothing for a chest a plate already covers and a great deal for the arms.

name: Utility Pouch
description: A nylon pouch that clips to webbing. Small, and exactly where a hand goes without thinking.

name: Riot Visor
description: A scratched polycarbonate face shield on a helmet bracket. It fogs, and you keep your face.
